# Exact Sciences

[Woman relaxing at sunset.]
Introducing

## Cancerguard^{®}

Our innovative multi-cancer early detection test.
We're united by a shared purpose: helping people live fuller lives through better health. Together,
we will transform the way cancer is detected, diagnosed and managed for more people around the
world.
[Exact Sciences is now ABBOTT.]
[Lab technician examining a test sample on a microscope slide.]
We’re fighting cancer every step of the way
[A smiling patient hugging a caregiver.]
So that everyone feels confident about their path forward

## ## We help bring clarity to cancer

Cancer creates so many uncertainties. We’re committed to answering questions, solving problems, and
making a lasting, positive impact on people's lives. Our tests explore hereditary risks, screen for
cancer’s presence, and examine the unique genomic alterations of an individual’s cancer after a
diagnosis to help guide their treatment.

## Everything starts with people

We’re focused on patients, providers, doctors, researchers, and caregivers. Our medical experts
partner with the industry’s best minds and collaborate with top institutions, advocacy partners, and
policymakers to help change lives and transform how the world approaches cancer.
[A woman named Deepa smiling.]

## A breast cancer surgeon's breast cancer journey

Hear how genomic testing helped Deepa and her doctor make an informed decision to forgo
chemotherapy.^{[*][15]}
[oncotype DX Breast Recurrence Score logo.]
[A woman named Leigh Anne smiling.]

## Convenient testing made early detection easy

Watch how testing at home helped Leigh Anne take the first step in diagnosing and treating her colon
cancer before it progressed.
[Cologuard by Exact Sciences logo.]
[Two Exact Sciences technicians working with lab equipment.]

## Fueling breakthroughs in cancer care

Our experience and process set us apart. Life-changing science. Deep expertise. Strong
collaboration. State-of-the-art labs. Rigorous research. The result? Proven accuracy, better
potential outcomes, and continuous progress in the fight against cancer.
[Two Exact Sciences technicians working with lab equipment.]

## Putting big ideas into action

Discover our DNA through our latest announcements and stories.
[Colorectal cancer survivors uniting at the Cologuard Classic by Exact Sciences.]

## The Power in Numbers

Colorectal cancer survivors unite at the Cologuard Classic by Exact Sciences to celebrate their
triumphs, build community

## Become part of something meaningful

Changing lives and achieving our purpose starts with our team and their commitment to fighting
cancer. Are you ready to make a difference? Explore open positions and learn why Exact Sciences has
been a certified Great Place To Work^{®} for seven years running
[Three Exact Sciences' associates collaborating in the Wisconsin headquarters' atrium.]
[An Exact Sciences associate writing on a white board while her colleagues look on.]
[An Exact Sciences customer representative smiling and talking on a phone headset.]

## Get in touch

Questions or comments? Find customer support, company contacts, and location information all in one
place.

## Footnotes
1. In addition to being an Oncotype DX^{®} Ambassador, Deepa occasionally serves in a professional
   capacity as a paid consultant of Exact Sciences. These services are unrelated to this activity.
1. Diergaarde B, Young G, Hall DW, et al. Circulating tumor DNA as a marker of recurrence risk in
   stage III colorectal cancer: the α-CORRECT study. *J Surg Oncol*. Jan 2025. (Suppl). doi:
   10.1002/jso.27989

## Testing specialties

### Gastroenterology

###### Gastroenterology

Our integration with a world-renowned medical center equips us with patient experience that supports
development of disease-specific, algorithmic-based testing approaches that provide faster answers
for each patient. Whether screening patients or monitoring therapeutic management, our evaluations
cover the full-spectrum of gastroenterology testing.

### Genetics

###### Genetics

Mayo Clinic Laboratories has been providing meaningful results to individuals seeking genetic
answers. Rare genetic disorders can be among the most difficult conditions to diagnose. To provide
meaningful answers, our genetic testing is developed and supported by an integrated team of
clinical, genetic, and laboratory experts and uses precision technologies to reveal variations
related to diagnosis and treatment. Built around a tradition of placing patients’ needs first, our
testing generates personalized insights to elevate understanding of a patient’s condition.

### Hematology

###### Hematology

Our comprehensive test menu has been created to aid in diagnosis and treatment selection across the
full spectrum of hematologic disorders. We have developed and validated practice-based, data-driven
algorithms that improve patient care, increase efficiency, and reduce costs. Our hematology experts
continuously drive innovation in laboratory testing, developing new approaches and using new
technology to address patient needs they see every day in clinical practice.

### Immunology

###### Immunology

Immunology testing at Mayo Clinic Laboratories is supported by a multidisciplinary team of experts
who apply the latest research to propel the development of meaningful assays. These tests are used
to assist with disease identification, monitoring of disease processes, and monitoring and treatment
of rare immunologic illnesses.

### Microbiology & Infectious Diseases

###### Microbiology & Infectious Diseases

Our internationally renowned clinical microbiology laboratories offer a broad selection of tests
designed for rapid identification and in-depth characterization of the causative agents of
infectious diseases. We have developed and implemented culture techniques, immunoassays,
antimicrobial susceptibility testing, and molecular methods for rapid detection, identification, and
characterization, as well as provision of treatment guidance for microbial pathogens.

malignancies. By offering testing for both acquired and inherited cancers in one place, we serve as
the singular source for all cancer testing.

### Pathology

###### Pathology

Mayo Clinic has the most robust laboratory and pathology practice for cancer care in the world,
offering testing that spans diagnostic, theranostic, and prognostic approaches. Integrated teams of
Mayo Clinic pathologists provide expertise for every type and stage of cancer. Our consultative
practice strives to provide the highest quality of diagnostic pathology, utilizing only ancillary
testing that supports diagnosis in a cost-effective, expedient manner.

### Pediatrics

###### Pediatrics

Mayo Clinic Laboratories understands your need to deliver timely and exceptional care to your
pediatric patients. That’s why we deliver the most patient-focused reference lab experience
possible. Unlike other reference labs, we offer advanced and accurate testing methods supported by
access to world-renowned Mayo Clinic specialists and over 150 years of experience informing
diagnoses and treatment plans to improve the health of children. Because we know it’s not only about
giving children the right care, it’s about giving them the best care.

# Exact Sciences

[Woman relaxing at sunset.]
Introducing

## Cancerguard^{®}

Our innovative multi-cancer early detection test.
We're united by a shared purpose: helping people live fuller lives through better health. Together,
we will transform the way cancer is detected, diagnosed and managed for more people around the
world.
[Exact Sciences is now ABBOTT.]
[Lab technician examining a test sample on a microscope slide.]
We’re fighting cancer every step of the way
[A smiling patient hugging a caregiver.]
So that everyone feels confident about their path forward

## ## We help bring clarity to cancer

Cancer creates so many uncertainties. We’re committed to answering questions, solving problems, and
making a lasting, positive impact on people's lives. Our tests explore hereditary risks, screen for
cancer’s presence, and examine the unique genomic alterations of an individual’s cancer after a
diagnosis to help guide their treatment.

## Everything starts with people

We’re focused on patients, providers, doctors, researchers, and caregivers. Our medical experts
partner with the industry’s best minds and collaborate with top institutions, advocacy partners, and
policymakers to help change lives and transform how the world approaches cancer.
[A woman named Deepa smiling.]

## A breast cancer surgeon's breast cancer journey

Hear how genomic testing helped Deepa and her doctor make an informed decision to forgo
chemotherapy.^{[*][15]}
[oncotype DX Breast Recurrence Score logo.]
[A woman named Leigh Anne smiling.]

## Convenient testing made early detection easy

Watch how testing at home helped Leigh Anne take the first step in diagnosing and treating her colon
cancer before it progressed.
[Cologuard by Exact Sciences logo.]
[Two Exact Sciences technicians working with lab equipment.]

## Fueling breakthroughs in cancer care

Our experience and process set us apart. Life-changing science. Deep expertise. Strong
collaboration. State-of-the-art labs. Rigorous research. The result? Proven accuracy, better
potential outcomes, and continuous progress in the fight against cancer.
[Two Exact Sciences technicians working with lab equipment.]

## Putting big ideas into action

Discover our DNA through our latest announcements and stories.
[Colorectal cancer survivors uniting at the Cologuard Classic by Exact Sciences.]

## The Power in Numbers

Colorectal cancer survivors unite at the Cologuard Classic by Exact Sciences to celebrate their
triumphs, build community

## Become part of something meaningful

Changing lives and achieving our purpose starts with our team and their commitment to fighting
cancer. Are you ready to make a difference? Explore open positions and learn why Exact Sciences has
been a certified Great Place To Work^{®} for seven years running
[Three Exact Sciences' associates collaborating in the Wisconsin headquarters' atrium.]
[An Exact Sciences associate writing on a white board while her colleagues look on.]
[An Exact Sciences customer representative smiling and talking on a phone headset.]

## Get in touch

Questions or comments? Find customer support, company contacts, and location information all in one
place.

## Footnotes
1. In addition to being an Oncotype DX^{®} Ambassador, Deepa occasionally serves in a professional
   capacity as a paid consultant of Exact Sciences. These services are unrelated to this activity.
1. Diergaarde B, Young G, Hall DW, et al. Circulating tumor DNA as a marker of recurrence risk in
   stage III colorectal cancer: the α-CORRECT study. *J Surg Oncol*. Jan 2025. (Suppl). doi:
   10.1002/jso.27989

offering testing that spans diagnostic, theranostic, and prognostic approaches. Integrated teams of

access to world-renowned Mayo Clinic specialists and over 150 years of experience informing
diagnoses and treatment plans to improve the health of children. Because we know it’s not only about

# Let’s get more people screened and protected.

Screening can detect cancer at an early stage. This toolkit will help you to support and encourage
more people to get screened and get early treatment if required.

Search for:

## Areas we support

### Breast

Together we can help more people access screening for the most common type of cancer in the UK.

[Read More][14]

### Bowel

Early symptoms of bowel cancer are hard to spot. Home screening can detect if something is present
in the test that may require further investigation, helping people to detect bowel cancer early and
get early treatment.

[Read More][15]

### Cervical

Cervical screening saves lives. Screening can detect changes in cells before they turn into cancer.

[Read More][16]

## Cheshire & Merseyside Statistics

###### There are 2.5 million people living in Cheshire and Merseyside
* ## 7,000
  
  cancer deaths in Cheshire and Merseyside every year. 290 people in every 100,000.
* ## 16,000
  
  people in Cheshire and Merseyside are diagnosed with cancer every year which is higher than the
  England average.
* ## 62.3%
  
  of the Cheshire and Merseyside population, age 70-74 years, completed and returned a bowel
  screening kit during 2020.
* ## 250,000
  
  women aged 50-70 have attended breast screening appointments in the past three years – that’s
  70.5% of the eligible population.
* ## 108,000
  
  women aged 25-39 screened attended a cervical screening appointment in the past five and half
  years in Cheshire and Merseyside – that’s 75% of the eligible population.

## Why is cancer screening important?

Catching cancer early saves lives. If we can detect it and start treatment early, it’s more likely
to work – and more people will survive. Screening is always a choice, and any aspect of the
screening process can be discussed with a health professional to enable an informed decision to be
made.

### Breast screening invitations

Invitations are sent every three years to women, some transgender men and some non-binary people
aged 50-71 (does not apply to 71+) who are registered with a GP.

### Bowel screening kits

All people aged 60-74 (now including 56 and 58-year-olds as of April 2021) registered with a GP are
sent a home screening kit every two years. If 75 years and over you can request a kit every two
years by phoning [0800 707 60 60][17].

### Cervical screening invitations

Invitations are sent to women, some transgender men and some non-binary people who are registered
with a GP. Every three years for 25–49-year-olds and every five years for 50–64-year-olds.

Early Detect Early Protect are positioned to provide resources to community health professionals and
encourage cancer screening to those who may be vulnerable.

vững chắc với hơn 20 năm kinh nghiệm trong ngành y tế. Đánh dấu bước ngoặt quan trọng vào năm 2022,
chúng tôi chính thức trở thành Nhà phân phối của Philips tại Việt Nam. Sự kết hợp giữa bề dày am
hiểu thị trường và công nghệ tiên tiến từ Philips giúp HAMEDCO cung cấp các hệ thống chẩn đoán hình
ảnh, giải pháp hồi sức cấp cứu vượt trội. Chúng tôi tập trung vào đội ngũ kỹ sư được đào tạo bài bản
và khắt khe, cam kết đồng hành cùng các bệnh viện để tối ưu vận hành, nâng cao độ chính xác trong
chẩn đoán và cải thiện chất lượng điều trị.

## DỊCH VỤ CỦA CHÚNG TÔI

Giải pháp toàn diện cho bệnh viện và cơ sở y tế Đồng hành từ tư vấn, triển khai đến vận hành và bảo
trì — đảm bảo hệ thống thiết bị hoạt động tối ưu, dữ liệu đồng bộ và nâng cao hiệu quả đầu tư.

### Giải pháp phòng mổ hiện đại

Thiết kế và triển khai giải pháp phòng mổ tích hợp theo tiêu chuẩn quốc tế, bao gồm hệ thống thiết
bị, khí y tế, kiểm soát nhiễm khuẩn và quản lý dữ liệu. Giúp nâng cao hiệu quả phẫu thuật, đảm bảo
an toàn và tối ưu quy trình vận hành.

### Giải pháp chẩn đoán hình ảnh

Cung cấp giải pháp đồng bộ cho các hệ thống MRI, CT, DSA, siêu âm, từ lựa chọn cấu hình thiết bị, bố
trí không gian đến tích hợp vận hành. Đảm bảo chất lượng hình ảnh, độ chính xác chẩn đoán và hiệu
suất khai thác thiết bị.

### Giải pháp hồi sức cấp cứu & ICU

Xây dựng giải pháp thiết bị cho khoa hồi sức cấp cứu với hệ thống monitoring, máy thở, thiết bị hỗ
trợ sự sống… đáp ứng yêu cầu điều trị liên tục, chính xác và an toàn cho bệnh nhân.

### Giải pháp nâng cấp & tối ưu hệ thống

Đánh giá hiện trạng và đề xuất phương án nâng cấp, mở rộng hoặc tối ưu hệ thống thiết bị hiện có,
giúp cải thiện hiệu suất hoạt động, kéo dài vòng đời thiết bị và tối ưu chi phí đầu tư.

### Giải pháp tích hợp & chuyển đổi số

Tư vấn và triển khai các giải pháp tích hợp thiết bị với hệ thống quản lý bệnh viện (HIS, RIS,
PACS…), đảm bảo kết nối dữ liệu đồng bộ, hỗ trợ quản lý hiệu quả và nâng cao chất lượng dịch vụ y
tế.

### Giải pháp kỹ thuật & vận hành thiết bị chuyên sâu

Cung cấp giải pháp toàn diện trong quản lý, vận hành, bảo trì và tối ưu hiệu suất cho các hệ thống
thiết bị y tế, đặc biệt là thiết bị chẩn đoán hình ảnh. Đảm bảo thiết bị hoạt động ổn định, duy trì
độ chính xác và giảm thiểu rủi ro gián đoạn.

### Giải pháp phòng mổ hiện đại

Thiết kế và triển khai giải pháp phòng mổ tích hợp theo tiêu chuẩn quốc tế, bao gồm hệ thống thiết
bị, khí y tế, kiểm soát nhiễm khuẩn và quản lý dữ liệu. Giúp nâng cao hiệu quả phẫu thuật, đảm bảo
an toàn và tối ưu quy trình vận hành.

### Giải pháp chẩn đoán hình ảnh

Cung cấp giải pháp đồng bộ cho các hệ thống MRI, CT, DSA, siêu âm, từ lựa chọn cấu hình thiết bị, bố
trí không gian đến tích hợp vận hành. Đảm bảo chất lượng hình ảnh, độ chính xác chẩn đoán và hiệu
suất khai thác thiết bị.

### Giải pháp hồi sức cấp cứu & ICU

Xây dựng giải pháp thiết bị cho khoa hồi sức cấp cứu với hệ thống monitoring, máy thở, thiết bị hỗ
trợ sự sống… đáp ứng yêu cầu điều trị liên tục, chính xác và an toàn cho bệnh nhân.

### Giải pháp nâng cấp & tối ưu hệ thống

Đánh giá hiện trạng và đề xuất phương án nâng cấp, mở rộng hoặc tối ưu hệ thống thiết bị hiện có,
giúp cải thiện hiệu suất hoạt động, kéo dài vòng đời thiết bị và tối ưu chi phí đầu tư.

### Giải pháp tích hợp & chuyển đổi số

Tư vấn và triển khai các giải pháp tích hợp thiết bị với hệ thống quản lý bệnh viện (HIS, RIS,
PACS…), đảm bảo kết nối dữ liệu đồng bộ, hỗ trợ quản lý hiệu quả và nâng cao chất lượng dịch vụ y
tế.

### Giải pháp kỹ thuật & vận hành thiết bị chuyên sâu

Cung cấp giải pháp toàn diện trong quản lý, vận hành, bảo trì và tối ưu hiệu suất cho các hệ thống
thiết bị y tế, đặc biệt là thiết bị chẩn đoán hình ảnh. Đảm bảo thiết bị hoạt động ổn định, duy trì
độ chính xác và giảm thiểu rủi ro gián đoạn.

## Đối tác tin cậy của hàng trăm bệnh viện trên toàn quốc

Chúng tôi cam kết mang đến giải pháp thiết bị y tế toàn diện cùng chất lượng dịch vụ vượt trội.

### Chính hãng 100%

Cam kết phân phối sản phẩm chính hãng từ các nhà sản xuất hàng đầu thế giới. Hồ sơ pháp lý đầy đủ,
bao gồm CO, CQ, giấy phép lưu hành trang thiết bị y tế theo quy định.

### Phản hồi kỹ thuật 24/7

Đội ngũ kỹ thuật chuyên sâu luôn sẵn sàng hỗ trợ 24/7.

### Chuyển giao công nghệ chuyên sâu

HAMEDCO đặc biệt chú trọng chuyển giao công nghệ chuẩn hóa với trọng tâm là đội ngũ kỹ sư được đào
tạo bài bản.

### Bảo hành và bảo trì toàn diện

Chính sách bảo hành chính hãng từ 12 đến 24 tháng. Kế hoạch bảo trì định kỳ và kho linh kiện dự
phòng.

### Hơn 20 năm kinh nghiệm thực chiến

Với hơn 20 năm đồng hành cùng ngành y tế Việt Nam, HAMEDCO thấu hiểu sâu sắc quy trình vận hành và
nhu cầu thực tiễn.

there/done that, someone who “gets it”— to get you to the finish line.

[ LEARN HOW TO ACE YOUR TEST ][15]
 

## "After 12 years working with hundreds of students in exactly your position, I can tell you it’s
## *not* lack of knowledge that’s keeping you from achieving the score that you want. In fact, you
## *probably already know 90% of the content you need* to ace your college admissions tests.

## What’s holding you back are the parts you can’t *just study away*."

 

# - Kristina Semos

### OWNER / FOUNDER

[800454.jpg]

**Work with founder kristina semos**

[*Read more about Kristina*][16]

 

# IVY LOUNGE PHILOSOPHY:

## Sure there is studying involved, but if you’re not studying the *right* material, not approaching
## it from the *proper* framework, not identifying the gaps in knowledge that you’re too close to
## even see, you can study 24/7 and you’ll never get there.

That’s where we come in. We school you on how to approach the test prep process strategically,
working *smarter*...not harder. (Oh, and by the way, these are also *key* skills you’re going to
need once you actually get in!) Our process helps you get laser focused on what you actually need to
work on to ace the test.

[Untitled-1.jpg]

## **And at Ivy Lounge Test Prep, we’re the ninjas needed to unlock your potential.**

Whether you’re math-phobic, test-phobic, school-phobic, or just a whip-smart achiever who wants to
go further, the first step to success is diagnosing your sticking points and prescribing a solution
specific to you with our:

## **[Ace the Test: Game Plan™][17]**

## What sets us apart

## Our people make the difference.

Life Line Screening appointments are conducted by a team of technicians that pair clinical precision
with genuine, personal care that doesn’t end with your screening.

## Specialists, not generalists

Our in-house technicians are specially trained in ultrasound imaging, EKG and blood analysis.

## Physician-reviewed

A board-certified physician reviews every result before it reaches you.

## Results you'll understand

We explain what your results mean in plain language. You leave knowing where you stand and what, if
anything, to do about it.

## Why it matters

## Could one screening save your life?

## For tens of thousands of people, it already has.

For 4 out of 5 people who have a stroke, the first symptom is the stroke itself. There’s no warning,
no chance to act, just a single life altering event caused by dangerous plaque buildup, irregular
heart rhythms, and arterial disease.

The vascular ultrasounds we offer aren’t typically available through a routine primary care visit.
We bring them directly to your neighborhood, with no referral needed, no insurance required, and no
months-long wait. Just a clear picture of your cardiovascular risk while there’s still time to do
something about it.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

# United Diagnostic Services

United Diagnostic Services LLC is an international company operating in the United States and
Canada, emphasizing early diagnosis and treatment through comprehensive diagnostic health programs.
The company offers comprehensive wellness screening and testing services, providing individuals with
a thorough assessment of their overall health status. UDS is committed to enabling timely diagnoses
and treatments to promote the health and well-being of its clients.

[Schedule Program Overview][20]
[badges flags full]

## Our Mission: Saving Lives Through Early Detection

United Diagnostic Services was born from a personal tragedy and a singular goal: to ensure no one
misses the chance for a life saving diagnosis. Founder Ray Lankin established our mission to deliver
advanced diagnostic services directly to those in high stress environments, including first
responders, educators, and corporate teams.

We go beyond traditional screenings by utilizing advanced full-body ultrasound and comprehensive
testing to identify cardiovascular diseases, cancers, and occupational health risks at their
earliest, most treatable stages. By combining professional medical expertise with a proactive
approach, we provide the clarity and security you need to focus on your future with confidence.

## Health Screening Excellence for the American Workforce

[[firefighter]][21]

### Fire & Emergency Services

Firefighters face extreme environments and heavy physical tolls every single day. Our team offers
the specialized diagnostics and on-site screenings needed to catch cardiovascular issues and cancers
early, ensuring those who protect us are protected too.

[Learn More][22]
[[law officer]][23]

### Law Enforcement Services

The mental and physical demands of policing require a high level of health vigilance. We provide
customized, confidential screenings that address high-stress impacts and occupational risks, helping
officers stay fit for duty and for their families.

[Learn More][24]
[ [firefighter] ][25]

### Energy & Infrastructure Services

Maintaining the grid exposes workers to unique hazards and EMF radiation^{}. Our mobile teams
provide the advanced imaging and blood panels required to detect chronic illness early^{}, keeping
the power on and the workforce healthy.

[Learn More][26]
[[hospitals]][27]

### Education & Faculty Wellness

Educators shape the future, but high-pressure classrooms can lead to chronic stress and burnout. We
bring proactive wellness directly to your school, offering targeted screenings that support staff
retention and long-term professional health.

[Learn More][28]
[[law officer]][29]

### Executive & Corporate Wellness

In high-stakes environments, sedentary routines and stress often hide silent health risks^{}. Our
white-glove service brings clinical excellence to your office^{}, identifying potential issues
before they impact leadership performance.

[Learn More][30]
[[hospitals]][31]

### Building Trades & Construction

Building our infrastructure means daily exposure to industrial carcinogens and physical
strain^{}^{}^{}^{}. We provide the precise, on-site diagnostics needed to detect occupational
diseases early^{}, protecting the longevity of the essential trades.

[Learn More][32]

# United Diagnostic Services

United Diagnostic Services LLC is an international company operating in the United States and
Canada, emphasizing early diagnosis and treatment through comprehensive diagnostic health programs.
The company offers comprehensive wellness screening and testing services, providing individuals with
a thorough assessment of their overall health status. UDS is committed to enabling timely diagnoses
and treatments to promote the health and well-being of its clients.

[Schedule Program Overview][20]
[badges flags full]

## Our Mission: Saving Lives Through Early Detection

United Diagnostic Services was born from a personal tragedy and a singular goal: to ensure no one
misses the chance for a life saving diagnosis. Founder Ray Lankin established our mission to deliver
advanced diagnostic services directly to those in high stress environments, including first
responders, educators, and corporate teams.

We go beyond traditional screenings by utilizing advanced full-body ultrasound and comprehensive
testing to identify cardiovascular diseases, cancers, and occupational health risks at their
earliest, most treatable stages. By combining professional medical expertise with a proactive
approach, we provide the clarity and security you need to focus on your future with confidence.

## Cancer Screening

**Treating cancer starts with knowing you have it.**
US Wellness has partnered with [GRAIL][31] to offer Galleri®, the first-of-its-kind multi-cancer
early-detection blood test.¹ Galleri detects a shared cancer signal across more than 50 types of
cancer, many which are not commonly screened for today.² With a simple blood draw, the Galleri test
can provide employees early detection insights that can help them be proactive about their health.
1. Galleri does not detect all cancers and all cancers cannot be detected in the blood. False
positive and false negative results do occur.
2. Klein EA, Richards D, Cohn A. et al. Clinical validation of a targeted methylation-based
multi-cancer early detection test using an independent validation set. Ann Oncol.

 
***US Wellness is proud to bring you Galleri in the fight against cancer.***

## What makes us different?
* **Licensed Health Professionals:** Our health screening teams are W-2 employees, led by licensed
  and certified professionals—including RNs, LPNs, and certified health coaches.

  coverage across all 50 states.

testing, and data tracking, we help entire populations achieve measurable, meaningful health
outcomes.

World Population:

Updated with the [2024 United Nations Revision][53]
* reached 8 billion in 2022, according to United Nations estimates.
* is projected to reach 9 billion in 2037, and 10 billion in 2060.
* has doubled in 40 years from 1959 (3 billion) to 1999 (6 billion).
* is currently (2025) growing at a rate of around 0.85% per year, adding around 70 million people
  per year to the total.
* growth rate reached its peak in the late 1960s, when it was at 2.09%.
* growth rate is currently declining and is projected to continue to decline in the coming years
  (reaching below 0.50% by 2047, reach 0 in 2084, and decline by -0.12% in 2100) .
* a tremendous change occurred with the industrial revolution: whereas it had taken all of human
  history up to the year 1800 for world population to reach 1 billion, the second billion was
  achieved in only 130 years (1930), the third billion in 30 years (1960), the fourth billion in 15
  years (1974), the fifth billion in 13 years (1987), the sixth billion in 11 years (1998), the
  seventh billion and eighth billion in 12 years each (2010 and 2022). During the 20th century
  alone, the population in the world has grown from 1.65 billion to 6 billion.

mobile services that reduce downtime, increase participation, and ensure compliance with
occupational health standards. Whether it’s drug and alcohol testing, biometric screenings, flu
shots, or full wellness events—we come to you, fully equipped and ready to serve.

With years of hands-on experience in the industry, our staff understands the unique needs of
businesses across various sectors. From small offices to large industrial sites, we provide tailored
solutions that fit your operations and schedule. Our professionalism, efficiency, and commitment to
care set us apart in the mobile health space.

At Complete Mobile Health, we believe that healthier employees make stronger businesses. Let us help

# Let’s get more people screened and protected.

Screening can detect cancer at an early stage. This toolkit will help you to support and encourage
more people to get screened and get early treatment if required.

Search for:

## Areas we support

### Breast

Together we can help more people access screening for the most common type of cancer in the UK.

[Read More][14]

### Bowel

Early symptoms of bowel cancer are hard to spot. Home screening can detect if something is present
in the test that may require further investigation, helping people to detect bowel cancer early and
get early treatment.

[Read More][15]

### Cervical

Cervical screening saves lives. Screening can detect changes in cells before they turn into cancer.

[Read More][16]

## Cheshire & Merseyside Statistics

###### There are 2.5 million people living in Cheshire and Merseyside
* ## 7,000
  
  cancer deaths in Cheshire and Merseyside every year. 290 people in every 100,000.
* ## 16,000
  
  people in Cheshire and Merseyside are diagnosed with cancer every year which is higher than the
  England average.
* ## 62.3%
  
  of the Cheshire and Merseyside population, age 70-74 years, completed and returned a bowel
  screening kit during 2020.
* ## 250,000
  
  women aged 50-70 have attended breast screening appointments in the past three years – that’s
  70.5% of the eligible population.
* ## 108,000
  
  women aged 25-39 screened attended a cervical screening appointment in the past five and half
  years in Cheshire and Merseyside – that’s 75% of the eligible population.

## Why is cancer screening important?

Catching cancer early saves lives. If we can detect it and start treatment early, it’s more likely
to work – and more people will survive. Screening is always a choice, and any aspect of the
screening process can be discussed with a health professional to enable an informed decision to be
made.

### Breast screening invitations

Invitations are sent every three years to women, some transgender men and some non-binary people
aged 50-71 (does not apply to 71+) who are registered with a GP.

### Bowel screening kits

All people aged 60-74 (now including 56 and 58-year-olds as of April 2021) registered with a GP are
sent a home screening kit every two years. If 75 years and over you can request a kit every two
years by phoning [0800 707 60 60][17].

### Cervical screening invitations

Invitations are sent to women, some transgender men and some non-binary people who are registered
with a GP. Every three years for 25–49-year-olds and every five years for 50–64-year-olds.

Early Detect Early Protect are positioned to provide resources to community health professionals and
encourage cancer screening to those who may be vulnerable.

## VỀ CHÚNG TÔI

Thành lập từ năm 2005, Công ty Cổ phần Vật tư và Thiết bị Y tế Hà Nội (HAMEDCO) đã khẳng định vị thế
vững chắc với hơn 20 năm kinh nghiệm trong ngành y tế. Đánh dấu bước ngoặt quan trọng vào năm 2022,
chúng tôi chính thức trở thành Nhà phân phối của Philips tại Việt Nam. Sự kết hợp giữa bề dày am
hiểu thị trường và công nghệ tiên tiến từ Philips giúp HAMEDCO cung cấp các hệ thống chẩn đoán hình
ảnh, giải pháp hồi sức cấp cứu vượt trội. Chúng tôi tập trung vào đội ngũ kỹ sư được đào tạo bài bản
và khắt khe, cam kết đồng hành cùng các bệnh viện để tối ưu vận hành, nâng cao độ chính xác trong
chẩn đoán và cải thiện chất lượng điều trị.

## DỊCH VỤ CỦA CHÚNG TÔI

Giải pháp toàn diện cho bệnh viện và cơ sở y tế Đồng hành từ tư vấn, triển khai đến vận hành và bảo
trì — đảm bảo hệ thống thiết bị hoạt động tối ưu, dữ liệu đồng bộ và nâng cao hiệu quả đầu tư.

### Giải pháp phòng mổ hiện đại

Thiết kế và triển khai giải pháp phòng mổ tích hợp theo tiêu chuẩn quốc tế, bao gồm hệ thống thiết
bị, khí y tế, kiểm soát nhiễm khuẩn và quản lý dữ liệu. Giúp nâng cao hiệu quả phẫu thuật, đảm bảo
an toàn và tối ưu quy trình vận hành.

### Giải pháp chẩn đoán hình ảnh

Cung cấp giải pháp đồng bộ cho các hệ thống MRI, CT, DSA, siêu âm, từ lựa chọn cấu hình thiết bị, bố
trí không gian đến tích hợp vận hành. Đảm bảo chất lượng hình ảnh, độ chính xác chẩn đoán và hiệu
suất khai thác thiết bị.

### Giải pháp hồi sức cấp cứu & ICU

Xây dựng giải pháp thiết bị cho khoa hồi sức cấp cứu với hệ thống monitoring, máy thở, thiết bị hỗ
trợ sự sống… đáp ứng yêu cầu điều trị liên tục, chính xác và an toàn cho bệnh nhân.

### Giải pháp nâng cấp & tối ưu hệ thống

Đánh giá hiện trạng và đề xuất phương án nâng cấp, mở rộng hoặc tối ưu hệ thống thiết bị hiện có,
giúp cải thiện hiệu suất hoạt động, kéo dài vòng đời thiết bị và tối ưu chi phí đầu tư.

### Giải pháp tích hợp & chuyển đổi số

Tư vấn và triển khai các giải pháp tích hợp thiết bị với hệ thống quản lý bệnh viện (HIS, RIS,
PACS…), đảm bảo kết nối dữ liệu đồng bộ, hỗ trợ quản lý hiệu quả và nâng cao chất lượng dịch vụ y
tế.

### Giải pháp kỹ thuật & vận hành thiết bị chuyên sâu

Cung cấp giải pháp toàn diện trong quản lý, vận hành, bảo trì và tối ưu hiệu suất cho các hệ thống
thiết bị y tế, đặc biệt là thiết bị chẩn đoán hình ảnh. Đảm bảo thiết bị hoạt động ổn định, duy trì
độ chính xác và giảm thiểu rủi ro gián đoạn.

Xây dựng giải pháp thiết bị cho khoa hồi sức cấp cứu với hệ thống monitoring, máy thở, thiết bị hỗ
trợ sự sống… đáp ứng yêu cầu điều trị liên tục, chính xác và an toàn cho bệnh nhân.

### Giải pháp nâng cấp & tối ưu hệ thống

Đánh giá hiện trạng và đề xuất phương án nâng cấp, mở rộng hoặc tối ưu hệ thống thiết bị hiện có,
giúp cải thiện hiệu suất hoạt động, kéo dài vòng đời thiết bị và tối ưu chi phí đầu tư.

### Giải pháp tích hợp & chuyển đổi số

Tư vấn và triển khai các giải pháp tích hợp thiết bị với hệ thống quản lý bệnh viện (HIS, RIS,
PACS…), đảm bảo kết nối dữ liệu đồng bộ, hỗ trợ quản lý hiệu quả và nâng cao chất lượng dịch vụ y
tế.

### Giải pháp kỹ thuật & vận hành thiết bị chuyên sâu

Cung cấp giải pháp toàn diện trong quản lý, vận hành, bảo trì và tối ưu hiệu suất cho các hệ thống
thiết bị y tế, đặc biệt là thiết bị chẩn đoán hình ảnh. Đảm bảo thiết bị hoạt động ổn định, duy trì
độ chính xác và giảm thiểu rủi ro gián đoạn.

## Đối tác tin cậy của hàng trăm bệnh viện trên toàn quốc

Chúng tôi cam kết mang đến giải pháp thiết bị y tế toàn diện cùng chất lượng dịch vụ vượt trội.

### Chính hãng 100%

Cam kết phân phối sản phẩm chính hãng từ các nhà sản xuất hàng đầu thế giới. Hồ sơ pháp lý đầy đủ,
bao gồm CO, CQ, giấy phép lưu hành trang thiết bị y tế theo quy định.

### Phản hồi kỹ thuật 24/7

Đội ngũ kỹ thuật chuyên sâu luôn sẵn sàng hỗ trợ 24/7.

### Chuyển giao công nghệ chuyên sâu

HAMEDCO đặc biệt chú trọng chuyển giao công nghệ chuẩn hóa với trọng tâm là đội ngũ kỹ sư được đào
tạo bài bản.

### Bảo hành và bảo trì toàn diện

Chính sách bảo hành chính hãng từ 12 đến 24 tháng. Kế hoạch bảo trì định kỳ và kho linh kiện dự
phòng.

### Hơn 20 năm kinh nghiệm thực chiến

Với hơn 20 năm đồng hành cùng ngành y tế Việt Nam, HAMEDCO thấu hiểu sâu sắc quy trình vận hành và
nhu cầu thực tiễn.

## **Freaked out about the ACT and the (gasp!) new Digital SAT? Have your sights set on your dream
## school but worried you won’t make the cut?**

If you’re here, we *know* you have the drive to get it done. Now all you need is a mentor who’s been
there/done that, someone who “gets it”— to get you to the finish line.

[ LEARN HOW TO ACE YOUR TEST ][15]
 

## "After 12 years working with hundreds of students in exactly your position, I can tell you it’s
## *not* lack of knowledge that’s keeping you from achieving the score that you want. In fact, you
## *probably already know 90% of the content you need* to ace your college admissions tests.

## What’s holding you back are the parts you can’t *just study away*."

 

# - Kristina Semos

### OWNER / FOUNDER

[800454.jpg]

**Work with founder kristina semos**

[*Read more about Kristina*][16]

 

# IVY LOUNGE PHILOSOPHY:

## Sure there is studying involved, but if you’re not studying the *right* material, not approaching
## it from the *proper* framework, not identifying the gaps in knowledge that you’re too close to
## even see, you can study 24/7 and you’ll never get there.

That’s where we come in. We school you on how to approach the test prep process strategically,
working *smarter*...not harder. (Oh, and by the way, these are also *key* skills you’re going to
need once you actually get in!) Our process helps you get laser focused on what you actually need to
work on to ace the test.

[Untitled-1.jpg]

## **And at Ivy Lounge Test Prep, we’re the ninjas needed to unlock your potential.**

Whether you’re math-phobic, test-phobic, school-phobic, or just a whip-smart achiever who wants to
go further, the first step to success is diagnosing your sticking points and prescribing a solution
specific to you with our:

## **[Ace the Test: Game Plan™][17]**

**The Ace the Test: Game Plan**

## What sets us apart

## Our people make the difference.

Life Line Screening appointments are conducted by a team of technicians that pair clinical precision
with genuine, personal care that doesn’t end with your screening.

## Specialists, not generalists

Our in-house technicians are specially trained in ultrasound imaging, EKG and blood analysis.

## Physician-reviewed

A board-certified physician reviews every result before it reaches you.

## Results you'll understand

We explain what your results mean in plain language. You leave knowing where you stand and what, if
anything, to do about it.

## Why it matters

## Could one screening save your life?

## For tens of thousands of people, it already has.

For 4 out of 5 people who have a stroke, the first symptom is the stroke itself. There’s no warning,
no chance to act, just a single life altering event caused by dangerous plaque buildup, irregular
heart rhythms, and arterial disease.

The vascular ultrasounds we offer aren’t typically available through a routine primary care visit.
We bring them directly to your neighborhood, with no referral needed, no insurance required, and no
months-long wait. Just a clear picture of your cardiovascular risk while there’s still time to do
something about it.

expanded to meet it.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

# United Diagnostic Services

United Diagnostic Services LLC is an international company operating in the United States and
Canada, emphasizing early diagnosis and treatment through comprehensive diagnostic health programs.
The company offers comprehensive wellness screening and testing services, providing individuals with
a thorough assessment of their overall health status. UDS is committed to enabling timely diagnoses
and treatments to promote the health and well-being of its clients.

[Schedule Program Overview][20]
[badges flags full]

## Our Mission: Saving Lives Through Early Detection

United Diagnostic Services was born from a personal tragedy and a singular goal: to ensure no one
misses the chance for a life saving diagnosis. Founder Ray Lankin established our mission to deliver
advanced diagnostic services directly to those in high stress environments, including first
responders, educators, and corporate teams.

We go beyond traditional screenings by utilizing advanced full-body ultrasound and comprehensive
testing to identify cardiovascular diseases, cancers, and occupational health risks at their
earliest, most treatable stages. By combining professional medical expertise with a proactive
approach, we provide the clarity and security you need to focus on your future with confidence.

## Health Screening Excellence for the American Workforce

[[firefighter]][21]

### Fire & Emergency Services

Firefighters face extreme environments and heavy physical tolls every single day. Our team offers
the specialized diagnostics and on-site screenings needed to catch cardiovascular issues and cancers
early, ensuring those who protect us are protected too.

[Learn More][22]
[[law officer]][23]

### Law Enforcement Services

The mental and physical demands of policing require a high level of health vigilance. We provide
customized, confidential screenings that address high-stress impacts and occupational risks, helping
officers stay fit for duty and for their families.

[Learn More][24]
[ [firefighter] ][25]

### Energy & Infrastructure Services

Maintaining the grid exposes workers to unique hazards and EMF radiation^{}. Our mobile teams
provide the advanced imaging and blood panels required to detect chronic illness early^{}, keeping
the power on and the workforce healthy.

[Learn More][26]
[[hospitals]][27]

### Education & Faculty Wellness

Educators shape the future, but high-pressure classrooms can lead to chronic stress and burnout. We
bring proactive wellness directly to your school, offering targeted screenings that support staff
retention and long-term professional health.

[Learn More][28]
[[law officer]][29]

### Executive & Corporate Wellness

In high-stakes environments, sedentary routines and stress often hide silent health risks^{}. Our
white-glove service brings clinical excellence to your office^{}, identifying potential issues
before they impact leadership performance.

[Learn More][30]
[[hospitals]][31]

### Building Trades & Construction

Building our infrastructure means daily exposure to industrial carcinogens and physical
strain^{}^{}^{}^{}. We provide the precise, on-site diagnostics needed to detect occupational
diseases early^{}, protecting the longevity of the essential trades.

[Learn More][32]

## Cancer Screening

**Treating cancer starts with knowing you have it.**
US Wellness has partnered with [GRAIL][31] to offer Galleri®, the first-of-its-kind multi-cancer
early-detection blood test.¹ Galleri detects a shared cancer signal across more than 50 types of
cancer, many which are not commonly screened for today.² With a simple blood draw, the Galleri test
can provide employees early detection insights that can help them be proactive about their health.
1. Galleri does not detect all cancers and all cancers cannot be detected in the blood. False
positive and false negative results do occur.

***US Wellness is proud to bring you Galleri in the fight against cancer.***

## What makes us different?
* **Licensed Health Professionals:** Our health screening teams are W-2 employees, led by licensed
  and certified professionals—including RNs, LPNs, and certified health coaches.
* **Participant Community Cloud:** A participant experience hub for onsite and offsite biometric
  appointments, with ongoing access to our health library, wellbeing workshops, and fresh content
  year-round.
* **CLIA Licensed Laboratory:** US Wellness operates as a CLIA-certified laboratory with licensed
  coverage across all 50 states.
* **Onsite and Offsite:** In addition to bringing our nurses to your worksites, we offer offsite
  access to biometric testing that comes together in your reporting.

## Precision Wellness

Precision Wellness begins with testing to identify health risks, existing diagnoses, family history,
and emerging concerns. From there, clinician-guided follow-up provides the personalized support
needed for each individual to take next steps and stay on track. By integrating coaching, lab
testing, and data tracking, we help entire populations achieve measurable, meaningful health
outcomes.

World Population:

Updated with the [2024 United Nations Revision][53]
* reached 8 billion in 2022, according to United Nations estimates.
* is projected to reach 9 billion in 2037, and 10 billion in 2060.
* has doubled in 40 years from 1959 (3 billion) to 1999 (6 billion).
* is currently (2025) growing at a rate of around 0.85% per year, adding around 70 million people
  per year to the total.
* growth rate reached its peak in the late 1960s, when it was at 2.09%.
* growth rate is currently declining and is projected to continue to decline in the coming years
  (reaching below 0.50% by 2047, reach 0 in 2084, and decline by -0.12% in 2100) .
* a tremendous change occurred with the industrial revolution: whereas it had taken all of human
  history up to the year 1800 for world population to reach 1 billion, the second billion was
  achieved in only 130 years (1930), the third billion in 30 years (1960), the fourth billion in 15
  years (1974), the fifth billion in 13 years (1987), the sixth billion in 11 years (1998), the
  seventh billion and eighth billion in 12 years each (2010 and 2022). During the 20th century
  alone, the population in the world has grown from 1.65 billion to 6 billion.
